behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Searching the Assignee dropdown narrows its choices to matching people.
behaviors.combined-filters: Selecting Priya while the status is To do shows only Draft release notes.
behaviors.unassigned-filter: Selecting Unassigned shows only Fix flaky upload test.
behaviors.empty-assignee: Selecting Ana shows an empty board with “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” and a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both filters and restores all four tasks.

history.notes: Locators use the toolbar to distinguish dropdown choices from task cards, and the empty-state button to distinguish the two Clear filters controls. The dropdown trigger is assumed to display its selected assignee label.
The Assignee popup is mounted outside the toolbar, so its choices are located through `.dd-popup.open`. The board and toolbar locators keep task and filter checks scoped to their respective areas.
